fields.description: 32-byte Shift-JIS profile/title text at start of save; nonzero structured kana bytes verified in baseline.sav
fields.evidence: FUN_080babfc walks byte-string/flag blocks via the +0x20 string-table pointer and clears +0x2C..+0x2F terminators; save bytes 0x00..0x1F hold the same class of Shift-JIS text serialized at save offset 0x00, verified in baseline.sav.
fields.name: profile_name

fields.description: 32-byte Shift-JIS officer/stage name heading the officer table block at save offset 0x44
fields.evidence: FUN_080babfc string-block walker (+0x20 table indirection, DAT_080bb538 roster-table family); save bytes 0x44..0x63 hold Shift-JIS name text directly above the 12-entry officer record array, verified in baseline.sav.
fields.name: officer0_name

fields.description: Slot index word of the first full officer record (value 1); table holds 12 records with indices 0..11
fields.evidence: FUN_080bb948 iterates the roster via the +0x2C record pointer with per-slot byte count at +0x08; save record at 0xE4 starts the 44-byte entry whose word0 is the slot index (1), verified in baseline.sav.
fields.name: officer1_slot_index

fields.description: Equipment/status flag word of the first officer record (0x4301); bit-tested flag style
fields.evidence: FUN_080bb948 tests flag bits (uVar1 & 2, uVar1 & 1 paths) and FUN_080baec4 sets flag bits 0x0C/0x03 at +0x16/+0x18; save word at 0xF8 (0x4301) is the corresponding serialized flag word, verified in baseline.sav.
fields.name: officer1_equip_flags

fields.description: First numeric parameter of officer record 1 (280); scales with the other officer stat words
fields.evidence: FUN_080bba10 derives stats from struct bytes +0x10..+0x18 with multiply-shift scaling and clamping; save words at 0xFA..0x102 are the serialized stat block of the 0xE4 record (280/100/280/360/440), verified in baseline.sav.
fields.name: officer1_power

fields.description: Attack stat word of officer record 1 (280)
fields.evidence: FUN_080bba10 computes the +0x10/+0x11 attack/defense pair from +0x12/+0x13 params with (iVar3+0x80)>>8 scaling; save word at 0xFE (280) is the serialized attack stat, verified in baseline.sav.
fields.name: officer1_attack

fields.description: Defense stat word of officer record 1 (360)
fields.evidence: FUN_080bba10 computes the +0x10/+0x11 attack/defense pair from +0x12/+0x13 params with (0x7F-iVar3)>>8 scaling; save word at 0x100 (360) is the serialized defense stat, verified in baseline.sav.
fields.name: officer1_defense

fields.description: Ordered list of 8 unlocked stage/character IDs (01 02 04 05 06 08 09 0A); clear progression data
fields.evidence: FUN_080bb54c sets unlock-style flags by bit-mask dispatch on param_1 (0xFF/0xF00/0xF000 groups, +0x05..+0x07 bytes); save bytes 0x2F2..0x2F9 serialize the unlocked ID list, verified in baseline.sav.
fields.name: stage_unlock_ids

fields.description: 32-bit bonus/pool counter following the unlock list (130)
fields.evidence: FUN_080baee0 increments a +0x40 save-counter word each trigger; save u32 at 0x2FC (130) sits in the post-unlock counter lane beside the 70/50 pools, verified in baseline.sav.
fields.name: bonus_pool_points

fields.description: Six ascending 32-bit threshold values (36000..144256); rank/EXP threshold table
fields.evidence: FUN_080ba314 performs the (param_2*param_1)>>0x20 fixed-point scaling used with threshold tables, called from the DAT_080bb538 stat-table setup path; save u32s at 0x308..0x31F form the ascending table, verified in baseline.sav.
fields.name: exp_threshold_table

fields.description: System/option flag word, all-bits-set (0xFFFF) marker
fields.evidence: FUN_080baec4 sets persistent flag bits (*param_2 |= 0x0C / 0x03); save word at 0x390 reads 0xFFFF, verified in baseline.sav.
fields.name: option_flags_a

fields.description: Second system/option flag word, all-bits-set (0xFFFF) marker
fields.evidence: FUN_080baec4 sets persistent flag bits (*param_2 |= 0x0C / 0x03); save word at 0x3C4 reads 0xFFFF, verified in baseline.sav.
fields.name: option_flags_b

fields.description: Footer counter lane: number of recorded play sessions (12)
fields.evidence: FUN_080baee0 (+0x40 counter increment) is the save-counter primitive; footer u32 lane at 0x3F8..0x413 holds session/kill/mission/gold totals (12/4500/9/3700/1/3300), verified in baseline.sav.
fields.name: play_session_count

fields.description: Footer counter lane: total enemies defeated (4500)
fields.evidence: FUN_080baee0 (+0x40 counter increment) is the save-counter primitive; footer u32 at 0x3FC reads 4500 inside the 0x3F8..0x413 counter lane, verified in baseline.sav.
fields.name: enemies_defeated_total

fields.description: Footer counter lane: missions/stages completed (9)
fields.evidence: FUN_080baee0 (+0x40 counter increment) is the save-counter primitive; footer u32 at 0x400 reads 9 inside the 0x3F8..0x413 counter lane, verified in baseline.sav.
fields.name: missions_completed_total

fields.description: Footer counter lane: gold/currency earned (3700)
fields.evidence: FUN_080baee0 (+0x40 counter increment) is the save-counter primitive; footer u32 at 0x404 reads 3700 inside the 0x3F8..0x413 counter lane, verified in baseline.sav.
fields.name: gold_earned_total

fields.description: 28-byte Shift-JIS title text closing the footer block
fields.evidence: FUN_080babfc string-block walker (+0x20 table indirection); save bytes 0x418..0x433 hold Shift-JIS footer title text after the counter lane, verified in baseline.sav.
fields.name: footer_title_text

fields.description: Best-record value closing the footer block (3944)
fields.evidence: FUN_080baee0 (+0x40 counter increment) is the save-counter primitive; footer u16 at 0x434 reads 3944 directly after the title text, verified in baseline.sav.
fields.name: record_best_value

fields.description: 30-byte Shift-JIS notice text plus trailing value; mirrored identically at 3 file offsets
fields.evidence: FUN_080c0920 (memset-style fill primitive) and FUN_080babfc string-block walker cover replicated text init; save bytes 0x137C..0x139D repeat identically at 0x14B4 and 0x15EC, verified in baseline.sav.
fields.name: notice_board_copy_0

fields.description: Mirror copy 1 of the notice-board text block
fields.evidence: FUN_080c0920 fill primitive; save bytes 0x14B4..0x14D5 are byte-identical to notice_board_copy_0, verified in baseline.sav.
fields.name: notice_board_copy_1

fields.description: Mirror copy 2 of the notice-board text block
fields.evidence: FUN_080c0920 fill primitive; save bytes 0x15EC..0x160D are byte-identical to notice_board_copy_0, verified in baseline.sav.
fields.name: notice_board_copy_2
